The full-scale reading is 100 V, and the guaranteed accuracy is 2% of full scale, so the maximum possible error is:  

\[
\text{Error} = 2\% \times 100 = 2 \text{ V}
\]

When measuring 75 V, the limiting error as a percentage of the reading is:  

\[
\frac{2}{75} \times 100\% \approx 2.666\%
\]

That matches 2.66% in the options.  

Final answer: (B)
